patthana16.65:1.1: anidassanaappaṭighaṃ sārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anidassanaappaṭigho na sārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: anidassanaappaṭighaṃ sārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassanasappaṭigho na sārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: …pe… anidassanaappaṭighaṃ sārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassanasappaṭigho na sārammaṇo ca na anidassanasappaṭigho na sārammaṇo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā:. hetuyā cha.
patthana16.65:2.1: anidassanaappaṭighaṃ anārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassanasappaṭigho na anārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. sanidassanattika cittaduke nasanidassanattika nocittadukaṃ
